# Durable service contract

the existing unit. Stored records must survive restart of that service and a
host reboot. The deployment must return without agent help after reboot.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Durable key-value HTTP service for the builder-app slot.

Endpoints:
  GET  /health         -> 200 "ready"
  PUT  /records/<id>   -> stores body, 204
  GET  /records/<id>   -> 200 exact stored body
"""
import os
import re
import sys
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

DATA_DIR = "/opt/builder/data"
PORT = 8080
MAX_BODY = 16 * 1024 * 1024  # 16 MiB safety cap

ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{1,255}$")


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "builder-app/1.0"
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    # --- helpers -------------------------------------------------------
    def _send(self, code, body=b"", ctype="application/octet-stream",
              extra=None):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        if extra:
            for k, v in extra.items():
                self.send_header(k, v)
        self.end_headers()
        if body and self.command != "HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(body)

    def _path_parts(self):
        # strip query string, split
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        parts = [p for p in path.split("/") if p]
        return parts

    def _record_path(self, rid):
        if not ID_RE.match(rid):
            return None
        return os.path.join(DATA_DIR, rid)

    def _read_body(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        if length < 0 or length > MAX_BODY:
            return None
        if length == 0:
            return b""
        return self.rfile.read(length)

    # --- routes --------------------------------------------------------
    def do_GET(self):
        parts = self._path_parts()
        if parts == ["health"]:
            self._send(200, b"ready", "text/plain")
            return
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "records":
            rp = self._record_path(parts[1])
            if rp is None:
                self._send(400, b"bad id\n", "text/plain")
                return
            if not os.path.exists(rp):
                self._send(404, b"not found\n", "text/plain")
                return
            with open(rp, "rb") as f:
                body = f.read()
            self._send(200, body, "application/octet-stream")
            return
        self._send(404, b"not found\n", "text/plain")

    def do_PUT(self):
        parts = self._path_parts()
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "records":
            rp = self._record_path(parts[1])
            if rp is None:
                self._send(400, b"bad id\n", "text/plain")
                return
            body = self._read_body()
            if body is None:
                self._send(413, b"body too large\n", "text/plain")
                return
            os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
            tmp = rp + ".tmp"
            with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
                f.write(body)
                f.flush()
                os.fsync(f.fileno())
            os.replace(tmp, rp)
            # best-effort dir fsync for crash durability
            try:
                dfd = os.open(DATA_DIR, os.O_RDONLY)
                try:
                    os.fsync(dfd)
                finally:
                    os.close(dfd)
            except OSError:
                pass
            self._send(204, b"")
            return
        self._send(404, b"not found\n", "text/plain")

    def do_HEAD(self):
        # treat like GET but no body
        self.do_GET()

    # quieter logging
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        sys.stderr.write("%s - %s\n" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args))


def main():
    os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler)
    httpd.daemon_threads = True
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
